name: Animated Card, Gargantuan
body:

Hearts Ranged +2 composite shortbow +8/+3 (1d10+16/x3)

Ranged 2 +1 darts +19/+14 (1d8+15)

STATISTICS

Str 38, Dex 8, Con -, Int -, Wis 1, Cha 1
Base Atk +10; CMB +28, CMD 37
Feats Dual SliceB, Power ThrowB, Rapid ShotB, Two-Weapon FightingB, Weapon Focus (shortbow)B

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or group (3-12)
